svg.title: MPLS: separate routing from service promises

g.text: MPLS: separate routing from service promises
Labels guide packets through the provider network.
The backbone can be shared while VPN traffic is logically separated.
Capacity planning, QoS and an agreed SLA define service expectations.
Congestion and failures can still cause delay, jitter or packet loss.
MPLS VPN separation is not encryption.
Use an agreed encryption layer when confidentiality requires it.
